purpose: Keeps the local preview server auditable against the deployed npsh.virsim.id package.

payload.thesisTitle: Modeling & Simulation of a Pumping System for Evaluating Cavitation Potential in Centrifugal Pumps Based on NPSH Analysis

securityPosture.publicFrontendRole: UI, bilingual labels, public-safe trace, release metadata, defense export packaging, and report presentation on the same origin as /api.
securityPosture.protectedBackendRole: Hydraulic/NPSH calculation, route trace, dependency manifest, parity gate, calculation audit, and defense export evidence context.
securityPosture.browserScriptSecrecyLimitation: Public JavaScript can be inspected by users; protection depends on keeping private solver source and operational secrets out of the public frontend.

cachePolicy.cacheBustedAssets: public, max-age=31536000, immutable; cache key must change whenever bytes change
